rationale: Reopened defect EPMCDME-13882: the temperature cap did not fire for Vertex Claude. Root cause verified against backend source — Claude-on-Vertex is served under LLMProvider.VERTEX_AI_ANTHROPIC = "vertex_ai-anthropic_models" (configs/llm_config.py:42, resolved in core/dependecies.py:269 and enterprise/litellm/models.py:80), a distinct string from google_vertexai (Gemini). The fix adds that one provider string to the capped-provider Set in temperatureConstraints.ts; azure_openai (DIAL Claude) is correctly left uncapped, so name-only matching would be wrong and the provider set is the right discriminator. Change is minimal (3 files, +67/-2), fully covered by 3 new unit cases and 1 new integration case, and verified live in the UI for both Bedrock and Vertex Claude (placeholder 0-1, 1.5 rejected with the Claude message, 1.0 accepted) plus a non-Claude regression (0-2, 1.5 accepted). 0 critical findings, 0 blocking findings.

standards_review.notes: EPMCDME-13882: capitalized imperative subject, single logical change.
One-line data change plus tests; rule table left extensible; comment documents all three provider strings and why azure_openai stays at 0-2. typecheck, lint, license-headers, gitleaks all pass.
Unit: predicate, getTemperatureMax, and Yup rejection for vertex_ai-anthropic_models. Integration: end-to-end reject-1.5 on a Vertex-Claude model. 86 targeted tests green.
Client-side validation data only; no security surface.
